thread:
Maya: quick sync — we need a stripped-down benchmark narrative for launch posts + webinar. focus: "speed vs bucks" not feature war. short, scannable charts + 1 strong headline.
Dario: love that. do we want 95th latency + $/1k tokens or something simpler?
Maya: keep two core axes: 'median latency (ms)' and 'unit cost ($ / 1k tokens)'. then a small inset showing tail latency for large prompt slices.
Lucas: +1. for visuals: one scatter (models by cost vs latency), one stacked bar (cost breakdown by batching/caching), and a tiny sparkline for tail.
Neha: copy idea: "Ship predictable LLM UX — fast where it matters, cheap where it doesn't." CTA: 'See our benchmark & try a live demo'.
Sam: routing question — what does inbound playbook look like? who gets leads from the webinar? sales SDRs or Solutions Eng?
Maya: primary: SDRs for self-serve upsell, secondary: Solutions Eng for Dedicated/Private inbound. tag routing: webinar -> marketing->sdr-funnel; demo signups -> se-touch.
Dario: sample chart callouts: "Same model family, different serving configs — 2x latency, 4x cost difference." need exact numbers from eng bench. @figma-bot can you start mockups?
figma-bot: Created file: https://figma.com/redwood/bench-visuals/sketch-001 — 3 frames: scatter, cost-breakdown, tail-spark.
Neha: quick A/B for headline? A: "Faster responses, lower token bills" B: "Cut inference costs without sacrificing speed" which wins?
Lucas: I prefer B for enterprise clarity. A feels clickbaity.
Maya: agreed B.
Sam: timeline: creative by Wed, copy locked Thu, assets to growth Fri. can eng provide bench numbers by Tue EOD?
Dario: I can get a first pass numbers + CSV by Tue afternoon. will include median/95/99 latencies and per-1k token unit cost across configs.
Neha: great — I'll write two micro-posts and a webinar blurb once numbers land. need a 1-line executive quote too.
Maya: assign: Dario = bench data, Lucas = viz comps, Neha = copy, Sam = routing + registration flow, me = final narrative + webinar script. keep updates here. :thumbsup:
Sam: routing note: capture plan: add a form field 'deployment interest' with options: Hosted / Dedicated / Private -> route accordingly.
Maya: perfect. last ask: keep charts readable for non-ML folks — simple labels, one-sentence takeaway under each chart.
Dario: noted. uploading starter CSV to /marketing/bench/ in drive after this thread.
Neha: will draft companion social copy variants for testing (short, mid, long).
Maya: excellent. if nothing else, this is our playbook — thanks everyone.
